an3.88:1.1: 89 sādhikamidaṃ bhikkhave diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha atthakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.
an3.88:1.2: tisso imā bhikkhave sikkhā yatthetaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati
an3.88:1.5: imā kho bhikkhave tisso sikkhā yatthetaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati.
an3.88:2.1: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī
an3.88:2.2: so yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjatipi vuṭṭhātipi
an3.88:2.4: na hi mettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā
an3.88:2.5: yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyakāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an3.88:2.6: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an3.88:2.7: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti
an3.88:2.8: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti
an3.88:2.9: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an3.88:2.10: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an3.88:2.11: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī
an3.88:2.12: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an3.88:2.13: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā ekabījī hoti ekaṃyeva mānusakaṃ bhavaṃ nibbattetvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an3.88:2.14: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā kolaṃkolo hoti dve vā tīṇi vā kulāni sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an3.88:2.15: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sattakkhattuparamo hoti sattakkhattuparamaṃ deve ca mānuse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an3.88:3.1: iti kho bhikkhave paripūraṃ paripūrakārī ārādheti padesaṃ padesakārī
